messages:
maya: FYI QA caught a mismatch between sample-app behavior and raw HTTP when we hit rate limits. Node SDK surfaces a generic "server_error" and 500-ish wrapper, but curl and proxy logs show 429. Also saw token refresh path return 401 and SDK treats it as transient and retries, which caused duplicate POSTs. Can we sync on error mapping + retry hints?

jordan: Ugh. Do we have the raw response bodies/logs? link to the sample app? :eyes:

maya: pasted the minimal repro below and logs. sample-app: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-chat/tree/error-handoff-test

--- curl output ---
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 2
{
  "error": "rate_limit",
  "message": "quota exceeded"
}
--- node SDK got ---
{
  "error": "server_error",
  "message": "request failed"
}
--- end ---

sanjay: That looks like our fetch wrapper swallowing status and remapping. In v1.3.2 we return a generic SDKError on any non-2xx and attach the body as message. The middleware stack loses the original httpStatus value. Quick snippet: 

```js
// libs/http.js
if (!res.ok) throw new SDKError({ message: await res.text() })
```

ciara: Oof. We need typed errors: RateLimitError (retry_after, retryable=false/true depending), AuthError (401/403 with retry_hint), ServerError (5xx, retryable=true). Also include a stable field like `original_http_status` and `retry_hint` (e.g., "backoff" | "do_not_retry") so sample apps and platform can programmatically decide.

jordan: Agreed. For parity we should: 1) preserve status code on the thrown error, 2) expose structured fields (type + retry_hint), and 3) add an integration test in sample-app that asserts mapping for 401/429/5xx. I can pick this up and open a PR.

maya: thanks. One nuance: some customers rely on current string message for monitoring, so we must keep `message` (human readable) and add `code` (typed code) so we don't break log parsers. E.g. `{ message, code: 'rate_limit', original_http_status: 429, retry_hint: 'backoff' }`.

sanjay: Makes sense. Implementation plan for Node SDK: 
- surface typed classes (RateLimitError extends SDKError)
- ensure http wrapper attaches `status` before any mapping
- update docs + changelog
- add sample-app e2e test using the fault-injector (mock 429 and 401)

ciara: For auth: do NOT auto-retry idempotent vs non-idempotent requests the same way. If token refresh fails + request was POST, emit AuthError with `retry_hint: do_not_retry` and add a helper `shouldRetry(err, request)` for sample apps. That will fix the duplicate writes.

jordan: I'll add `shouldRetry` util in the SDK and wire it into the default http client. Will also keep a feature flag to preserve current behavior for one release (compat).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: candidate release 1.3.3-preview created for branch "error-mapping/node" - CI triggered :rocket:

maya: Action items: jordan -> PR for node SDK mapping + tests; sanjay -> audit other SDKs (py/go) for same pattern; ciara -> spec doc for typed errors & retry_hint; maya -> update sample-app tests + QA flaky test. I'll drive the rollout. :thumbsup:

ciara: I'll write the spec in docs/error-handling.md and tag you all. We should include example snippets for monitoring + alerting (e.g., alert on code==rate_limit not on message text). :party_parrot:

jordan: Sounds good. Will target PR by EOD tomorrow.

maya: Thanks team. Let's avoid another customer hit like this.
